entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: As I have told you several times, I do not[n]recall having written the book you're[n]referring to...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But that's what it says on the internet...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So then, who the heck wrote it!?

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: How should I know? I am very sorry,[n]but I cannot help you.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Now, if there is nothing else, please leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You totally believe everything that's[n]written on the internet!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's pretty cute, huh? Was she there[n]when we got here?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Why's she playin' shogi inside[n]a church?

entries.speaker: Priest's Voice
entries.en: Is there a reason for you to still be here?[n]No? Then please leave!
